```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(brms)
library(ggplot2)
# data-derived text: backslash-escaped markdown punctuation renders literally in HTML, Word, and PDF
# brackets become entities because \( and \[ would render as math
md_ent <- c("(" = "&#40;", ")" = "&#41;", "[" = "&#91;", "]" = "&#93;")
md_text <- function(x) Reduce(function(s, k) gsub(k, md_ent[[k]], s, fixed = TRUE), names(md_ent),
                              gsub("([`*_{}#+!|<>$\\\\])", "\\\\\\1", gsub("[\r\n]", " ", as.character(x))))
md_table <- function(df) {
  df[] <- lapply(df, function(x) if (is.character(x) || is.factor(x)) md_text(x) else x)
  rownames(df) <- md_text(rownames(df))
  df
}
```

```{r eval="methods" %in% params$sections, results='asis'}
cat("## Methods\n\n")
cat(sprintf("A Bayesian multilevel model was fitted using the `brms` package with the following specification:\n\n"))
cat(sprintf("**Formula:** %s\n\n", md_text(paste(params$formula_str, collapse = " "))))
cat(sprintf("**Family:** %s\n\n", md_text(params$family)))
if (!is.null(params$model)) {
  n_chains <- params$model$fit@sim$chains
  n_iter <- params$model$fit@sim$iter
  n_warmup <- params$model$fit@sim$warmup
  cat(sprintf("**MCMC:** %d chains, %d iterations (%d warmup)\n\n", n_chains, n_iter, n_warmup))
}
if (is.data.frame(params$priors) && nrow(params$priors) > 0) {
  cat("**Priors:** source is the brms default, the scdbayes default or prior-type preset,",
      "a prior adopted from the AI co-design dialog, or a manual override.\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(md_table(params$priors), caption = "Priors used in the fitted model"))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

```{r eval="results" %in% params$sections && !is.null(params$results), results='asis'}
if (!is.null(params$results$effects)) {
  ef <- params$results$effects
  cat("\n### Phase descriptives\n\n")
  if (!is.na(ef$raw_difference)) cat(sprintf("- Raw mean difference (B - A): %.3f\n", ef$raw_difference))
  if (!is.null(ef$phase_a_mean)) cat(sprintf("- Phase A mean: %.3f (n = %d)\n", ef$phase_a_mean, ef$phase_a_n))
  if (!is.null(ef$phase_b_mean)) cat(sprintf("- Phase B mean: %.3f (n = %d)\n", ef$phase_b_mean, ef$phase_b_n))
}
if (!is.null(params$results$posterior_decisions)) {
  pd <- params$results$posterior_decisions$population_contrast
  cat("\n### Posterior phase contrast on the response scale\n\n")
  cat(sprintf("- Posterior mean: %.3f (SD %.3f)\n", pd$mean, pd$sd))
  cat(sprintf("- %.0f%% credible interval: [%.3f, %.3f]\n",
              100 * (if (is.null(params$results$posterior_decisions$metadata$ci_level)) 0.95
                     else params$results$posterior_decisions$metadata$ci_level),
              pd$lower, pd$upper))
  cat(sprintf("- Probability of direction: %.3f\n", pd$pd))
  if (!is.null(pd$prob_meaningful_change)) {
    cat(sprintf("- Probability of meaningful change: %.3f\n", pd$prob_meaningful_change))
  }
  if (!is.null(pd$rope_prob)) {
    cat(sprintf("- ROPE probability: %.3f\n", pd$rope_prob))
  }
}
if (!is.null(params$results$posterior_decisions$per_case_contrast)) {
  cat("\n### Per-case posterior phase contrast\n\n")
  knitr::kable(md_table(params$results$posterior_decisions$per_case_contrast), digits = 3)
} else if (!is.null(params$results$per_case_es) && nrow(params$results$per_case_es) > 0) {
  cat("\n### Per-case posterior decisions\n\n")
  knitr::kable(md_table(params$results$per_case_es), digits = 3)
}
```

```{r eval="diagnostics" %in% params$sections && !is.null(params$model), results='asis'}
cat("## Diagnostics\n\n")
diag <- scdbayes::compute_convergence_diagnostics(params$model)
fmt_max <- function(v, f) if (any(is.finite(v))) sprintf(f, max(v[is.finite(v)])) else "not available"
fmt_min <- function(v) if (any(is.finite(v))) sprintf("%.0f", min(v[is.finite(v)])) else "not available"
verdict <- if (isTRUE(diag$converged$converged)) "pass" else if (isFALSE(diag$converged$converged)) "fail" else "not established"
cat(sprintf(paste0("- Convergence (R-hat < 1.01, bulk and tail ESS > 400, no divergences, no max-treedepth hits): %s\n",
                   "- Max R-hat: %s\n- Min bulk ESS: %s\n- Min tail ESS: %s\n- Divergent transitions: %s\n"),
            verdict, fmt_max(diag$basic$rhat, "%.4f"), fmt_min(diag$basic$ess_bulk),
            fmt_min(diag$basic$ess_tail), format(if (is.null(diag$divergence$n_divergent)) NA else diag$divergence$n_divergent)))
loo_result <- tryCatch(loo(params$model), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(loo_result)) cat(sprintf("- LOO-IC: %.1f (SE: %.1f)\n", loo_result$estimates["looic", "Estimate"], loo_result$estimates["looic", "SE"]))
k_max <- min(1 - 1 / log10(posterior::ndraws(params$model)), 0.7)
if (!is.null(loo_result)) cat(sprintf("- Pareto k above %.2f: %d of %d observations\n", k_max,
                                      sum(loo_result$diagnostics$pareto_k > k_max), length(loo_result$diagnostics$pareto_k)))
```
